method: Partial Ghidra11.4.2 body inventory, checked with Capstone. Ranges omit inter-block/function gaps. All one-byte entries are excluded. Native/CRT partition uses the layout boundary at verified mainCRTStartup 0x509d0, not complete library provenance. Imports are IAT-resolving FF25 thunks. Unclassified includes accepted bodies absent from this old inventory, inline data and padding; it is not all padding. This is not branch coverage or a complete body denominator.

limits: Remaining closures are analysis opportunities, not promised gains. OMF closure includes internal -g debug conversion, while normal LINK wrapper requests only -o/-co. No additional cases were executed.
